questions.q: Excuse me, do you know where ______? 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: Do you know 後面的間接問句用直述句語序：where＋主詞＋動詞，the accounting department is；不倒裝、不加 does。

questions.q: The discussion focused on ______ the company should open a second branch. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 介系詞 on 後面帶出「是不是」，只能用 whether，不用 if。what 放進去，open 的受詞 a second branch 已經有了。

questions.q: ______ impressed the visiting clients most was the product demonstration. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: impressed 少了主詞，What（＝the thing that）補上，What impressed the visiting clients most 整段當主詞。That 後面要完整的句子；Which 前面要有先行詞。

questions.q: The safety policy requires that every worker ______ a helmet on the construction site. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: require（要求）＋that＋主詞＋原形：wear，主詞 every worker 也不加 -s。wearing、to wear、worn 都不能當子句的動詞。

questions.q: The supplier informed ______ the price of steel would rise next month. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: inform 和 tell 一樣，先接聽的人再接 that 子句：informed us that。後面的 the price of steel would rise 是完整的句子，what 沒有位置。

questions.q: We have not decided ______ or not to attend the trade fair in Berlin. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 緊接 or not、後面又接 to 不定詞，兩個條件都只能用 whether。

questions.q: Several new employees still don't know how ______ the online booking system. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 疑問詞＋to 不定詞：how to use（怎麼用）。how 後面不直接接 -ing、原形或過去分詞。

questions.q: ______ is clear that the project will need more funding next year. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: It 是虛主詞，真正的主詞是後面的 that 子句：It is clear that…。That、What、This 放在句首都會讓後面多出一個沒有位置的 that 子句。

questions.q: The manager wants to find out who ______ the order without approval. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: who 本身是主詞（誰下了訂單），語序不變，直接接動詞 placed。was placed 是被動，後面卻還有受詞 the order；placing 沒有時態。

questions.q: Even though the audit found several errors, the accountant insisted that his figures ______ correct. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 這裡的 insist 是「堅稱某件事是真的」，不是要求，所以照一般時態用 were。只有「要求」的 insist 後面才用原形 be。
